text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way home, in front of the 
station……

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I want to buy a ticket, but the 
crowd's so thick I can't even reach the 
ticket machine.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list:
Let's brace ourselves and push forward 
against the current.
Let's read the flow and move forward.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Dig deep and hold my ground, huh... 
Understood. I'm good at that sort of 
thing.

Stepping resolutely into the crowd, Oguri 
Cap forged ahead, pushing her way 
through...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I managed to buy it somehow. That 
took quite a bit more effort than I 
expected.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Man, who knew buying a ticket from a 
vending machine could be such a 
struggle...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, thank you. You've been a big help. 
Well then, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Read the flow of things... huh. I see, 
let's give that a shot.

Oguri Cap slowly pushed through the crowd 
and burst out of the flow right in front 
of the ticket machine.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the advice. I managed to buy 
the ticket without trouble.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like the train is about to 
arrive. Well then, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Gotta read the flow of things... and 
there.

Matching the surrounding pace before 
breaking out at the end. This might prove 
useful on courses that tend to result in a 
slow pace.
